features.title: Almond shade that warms your room
features.text: Smooth synthetic leather in almond brown wipes clean and pairs with woods, whites, and neutrals, so your space feels welcoming without high-maintenance care.

features.title: Adjustable headrests for your perfect angle
features.text: Tilt and lock each headrest at multiple angles until your neck, shoulders, and screen line up comfortably, whether you are reading, streaming, or dozing after a long day.

features.title: Pocket-spring seat that keeps comfort buoyant
features.text: Pocket springs under supportive foam create a balanced, buoyant sit, so longer sessions feel easy on your body and the seat holds its comfort through everyday use.

features.title: Lumbar support that helps you unwind
features.text: Gentle lower-back contouring encourages a relaxed posture, helping you release tension and rise feeling more rested after your favourite show or a late-afternoon nap.

features.title: Wide armrests for real rest
features.text: Broad, softly edged armrests give your elbows and wrists a natural landing, making scrolling, reading, or simply sitting back feel steadier and more relaxed.

name: Pebby 3-Seater Synthetic Leather Sofa With Adjustable Headrest
